description: Header file defining the NinjaBuildWriter class responsible for generating and managing Ninja build files within the GN build system. Contains class declarations, method signatures, and includes relevant to build file generation.

classes.name: NinjaBuildWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Ninja build files, handling regeneration rules, and managing build targets and toolchains.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Static method to extract build information from Builder and write the build.ninja file.

methods.name: ExtractRegenerationCommands
methods.description: Static method to extract regeneration commands from an existing build.ninja file.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the build file generation process.

methods.name: WriteNinjaRules
methods.description: Writes rules for regenerating Ninja build files, including workarounds for Ninja's behavior.

methods.name: WriteAllPools
methods.description: Writes all pool definitions for Ninja.

methods.name: WritePhonyAndAllRules
methods.description: Writes phony rules and all associated rules.

methods.name: WritePhonyRule
methods.description: Defines a phony rule for a specific target.
